sponsor_or_proposer: Karpowership (Banjul powership operator since 2018); KARMOL (Karpowership + Mitsui O.S.K. Lines JV) named The Gambia in its 2019 LNG-to-power ambitions; Government of The Gambia (planned LNG import as a bridging measure per US ITA country guide).
current_state: Karpowership's powership off Banjul remains The Gambia's only IPP and runs on HFO. A 2019 Karpowership/MOL (KARMOL) announcement flagged LNG-to-power service for The Gambia, and the government has discussed importing LNG as a bridge while awaiting regional gas, but as of 2026-07 no FSRU/FSU charter, no LNG supply agreement, no site and no concrete step has been announced. KARMOL's first West African LNG conversion went to Dakar (Senegal, operating 2025); trade press touts it as a 'regional expansion catalyst' without a named Gambia project.
missing_threshold_elements: Concrete step (no charter/MOU/tender/permit for a Gambia LNG import facility); no capacity; no committed sponsor for an LNG terminal (powership operator presence is not an LNG terminal commitment).
watch_for: A KARMOL/Karpowership FSU or M-FSRU charter for Banjul; conversion of the Banjul powership to gas; a government LNG import tender or supply MOU; NAWEC procurement naming LNG. If a supplied-by-sea unit is chartered for Banjul, promote to new_terminals (Dakar-style).
